question: What practical advice does Aparna Chennapragada give for deciding whether it’s the right time to pursue a zero-to-one product idea?
expected_points: Look for a technology shift, a consumer behavior shift, and a business model shift.
At least two of the three should be present.
evidence_quote: you do want to look for at least two out of these three factors, inflection points here if you want to make a really good product.
